snippet.title: 🔥 IShowSpeed's Emotional GTA 6 Ending! 💔😭 52 Hours Straight to Finish It! #shorts #foryou
snippet.description: YouTuber Darren "IShowSpeed" Watkins became the second streamer to complete Grand Theft Auto VI after finishing the main story campaign in 52 hours and 30 minutes during a continuous, sleepless streaming marathon. Upon reaching the conclusion, Watkins became emotional and broke down in tears after unlocking "The Failed Escape," one of the game's darkest endings in which both protagonists, Jason and Lucia, are killed at a police roadblock. The broadcast peaked at 392,500 concurrent viewers—marking the largest livestream in his YouTube channel's history—though his decision to stream the game's ending also drew criticism from some viewers.😭🔥

snippet.title: Kai Cenat Got the WORST Ending in GTA 6 — "They Did Not Have to Kill Him Like That!" 😱

A main character gets killed in the final mission — "They did not have to kill him like that, bro." There was no "death wish" option, no ABC choice, and when the credits roll, the game just ENDS. No free roam. Nothing.

But then Kai gives his honest verdict: the graphics and realism are a 10 out of 10 — "a completely different game from GTA 5." Was this the worst GTA ending ever, or the most emotional one? Drop it in the comments! 👇
